permissions.label: Open DataConnect
permissions.description: May open the DataConnect application at all (portal menu entry). Grants no data access by itself.

permissions.label: View the dashboard
permissions.description: Open the DataConnect dashboard page.

permissions.label: View monitoring
permissions.description: Live data-flow, Kafka Connect cluster/connector/task status, runtime metrics and failure breakdowns.

permissions.label: View connections
permissions.description: List and read connection profiles (secrets masked) and the connection field schemas.

permissions.label: Edit connections
permissions.description: Create, update and delete connection profiles.

permissions.label: Test connections and discover sources
permissions.description: Run live test-connection probes against a source and start/read source schema discovery runs.

permissions.label: View pipelines
permissions.description: List and read pipelines, their status, operations and topic policies.

permissions.label: Edit pipelines
permissions.description: Create, update and delete pipelines and topic policies.

permissions.label: Deploy pipelines
permissions.description: Deploy a pipeline, check its deploy readiness and view its generated Kafka Connect configuration.

permissions.label: Operate pipelines
permissions.description: Pause, resume and restart deployed pipelines.

permissions.label: View schemas
permissions.description: List and read schema versions, drift events and drift approvals.

permissions.label: Edit schemas
permissions.description: Infer schemas, create schema versions, validate compatibility, detect drift and request drift approvals.

permissions.label: Approve schema drift
permissions.description: Approve or reject a pending schema drift approval.

permissions.label: View data quality
permissions.description: List and read quality policies, results, stream statistics and execution jobs.

permissions.label: Edit data quality
permissions.description: Create, update, delete, validate, preview and execute quality policies.

permissions.label: View lineage
permissions.description: List lineage assets and read lineage graphs.

permissions.label: Record lineage
permissions.description: Ingest lineage events (POST /lineage/events).

permissions.label: View transforms
permissions.description: List and read transform (SMT) policies.

permissions.label: Edit transforms
permissions.description: Create, update, delete, validate and preview transform policies.

permissions.label: View connector templates
permissions.description: Browse the connector template catalog and template revisions.

permissions.label: Manage connector templates
permissions.description: Create, update and delete connector templates.

permissions.label: View settings
permissions.description: Open the DataConnect Settings page (UI only; no server route).

permissions.label: Edit settings and support diagnostics
permissions.description: Change DataConnect settings and download the redacted support diagnostics bundle.

permissions.label: View audit history
permissions.description: Read the audit / history log.

permissions.label: View alerts
permissions.description: List and read alerts, their counts and history, the alert rules and the Slack / Teams channels (webhook URLs are never returned).

permissions.label: Acknowledge and resolve alerts
permissions.description: Acknowledge or resolve an alert from the Alerts page.

permissions.label: Manage alert rules and channels
permissions.description: Create, update and delete alert rules and Slack / Teams channels, send a test message and run the rules now. A channel's webhook URL is a credential.
